``` {r loading_configuration}
Daily_Checks <- read.csv("G:/My Drive/Inzights/Journey/July 2026 Longitudinal/Daily Checkins.csv")

Daily_Checks$DAILY <- 1

colnames(Daily_Checks)[colnames(Daily_Checks) == "CHECKINDATE"] <- "EVENTDATE"

Monthly_Assessments <- read.csv("G:/My Drive/Inzights/Journey/July 2026 Longitudinal/Monthly Assessments.csv")

Monthly_Assessments$MONTHLY <- 1

colnames(Monthly_Assessments)[colnames(Monthly_Assessments) == "ASSESSMENTDATE"] <- "EVENTDATE"

Platform_Events <- read.csv("G:/My Drive/Inzights/Journey/July 2026 Longitudinal/Platform Events.csv")

#Comprehensive_DF <- merge(Monthly_Assessments, Platform_Events, by = c('USERID', 'EVENTDATE'), all.x = TRUE)

drop_list <- c("\\[", "\"", " ", "\\]")

pattern <- paste0(drop_list, collapse = "|")

Platform_Events$PLATFORMEVENTS <- gsub(pattern, "", Platform_Events$PLATFORMEVENTS)

Platform_Events <- Platform_Events %>%
  mutate(PLATFORMEVENTS = map_chr(str_split(PLATFORMEVENTS, ","), ~ paste(unique(str_trim(.x)), collapse = ",")))

Platform_Events <- Platform_Events %>%
  separate_longer_delim(PLATFORMEVENTS, delim = ",") %>%
  mutate(PLATFORMEVENTS = trimws(PLATFORMEVENTS), present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = PLATFORMEVENTS,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn = max # Ensures a 1 is kept if a word accidentally repeats in a cell
  )

Comp_DF <- merge(Platform_Events, Daily_Checks, by = c('USERID', 'EVENTDATE'), all.x = TRUE)

Comp_DF <- merge(Comp_DF, Monthly_Assessments, by = c('USERID', 'EVENTDATE'), all.x = TRUE)

Comp_DF <- Comp_DF[,-c(35,36,39)]

Comp_DF$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(Comp_DF$EVENTDATE)

Comp_DF$FEELINGRATING[Comp_DF$FEELINGRATING == 0 | Comp_DF$FEELINGRATING == 6] <- NA

```

# Case Counts

``` {r monthly_case_counts}

abc <- Comp_DF %>%
  mutate(EVENTDATE = as.Date(EVENTDATE)) %>%
  arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%           # <-- added: cumsum() needs chronological order
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(
    PERIOD = cumsum(!is.na(MONTHLY)),      # <-- added: recreate PERIOD, same logic as before
    .baseline_date = min(EVENTDATE, na.rm = TRUE),

    .start_window = !is.na(.baseline_date) &
      EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date %m+% months(5) &
      EVENTDATE <= .baseline_date %m+% months(7),

    .start_date = suppressWarnings(min(
      EVENTDATE[.start_window & !is.na(PERIOD_RISK) & PERIOD_RISK == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    .start_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.start_date), NA, .start_date), origin = "1970-01-01"),

    START_RISK = as.integer(!is.na(.start_date) & PERIOD_RISK == 1 & EVENTDATE == .start_date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. build_end_risk(): computes END_RISK for an arbitrary follow-up
#    window of `target_months` after START_RISK.
#    window = [target_months - 1, target_months + 1], tie-break at
#    exactly `target_months`.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
build_end_risk <- function(data, target_months) {
  data <- data %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      .in_window = !is.na(.start_date) &
        EVENTDATE >= .start_date %m+% months(target_months - 1) &
        EVENTDATE <= .start_date %m+% months(target_months + 1),

      .end1_date = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[.in_window & PERIOD_RISK == 1 & !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .end1_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.end1_date), NA, .end1_date), origin = "1970-01-01")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  period_clean <- data %>%
    filter(.in_window) %>%
    group_by(USERID, PERIOD) %>%
    summarise(.period_all_zero = all(!is.na(PERIOD_RISK) & PERIOD_RISK == 0), .groups = "drop")

  data <- data %>% left_join(period_clean, by = c("USERID", "PERIOD"))

  max_clean_period <- data %>%
    filter(.in_window, .period_all_zero) %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(.max_period0 = max(PERIOD), .groups = "drop")

  data %>%
    left_join(max_clean_period, by = "USERID") %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      .end0_date = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[.in_window & !is.na(.max_period0) & PERIOD == .max_period0 &
                    !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .end0_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.end0_date), NA, .end0_date), origin = "1970-01-01"),

      # tie-break: keep whichever candidate is closest to `target_months`
      .target_mark = .start_date %m+% months(target_months),
      .dist1 = abs(as.numeric(.end1_date - .target_mark)),
      .dist0 = abs(as.numeric(.end0_date - .target_mark)),
      .keep1 = !is.na(.end1_date) & (is.na(.end0_date) | .dist1 <= .dist0),
      .keep0 = !is.na(.end0_date) & (is.na(.end1_date) | .dist0 <  .dist1),

      END_RISK = case_when(
        .keep1 & PERIOD_RISK == 1 & !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1 & EVENTDATE == .end1_date ~ 1L,
        .keep0 & PERIOD_RISK == 0 & !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1 & EVENTDATE == .end0_date ~ 0L,
        TRUE ~ NA_integer_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-starts_with("."))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. build_outcome_table(): from a data frame that already has
#    START_RISK + END_RISK for one follow-up window, produces one row
#    per USERID with START_RISK, END_RISK_<suffix>,
#    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_<suffix>, and each of `score_cols` measured AT
#    the END_RISK marker's EVENTDATE (named "<col>_AT_END_RISK_<suffix>")
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
build_outcome_table <- function(data_with_end_risk, journey_df, suffix, score_cols) {

  risk_subset <- data_with_end_risk %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    filter(any(START_RISK == 1, na.rm = TRUE) & any(!is.na(END_RISK))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(USERID, PERIOD, EVENTDATE) %>%
    group_by(USERID, PERIOD) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(START_RISK == 1 | !is.na(END_RISK)) %>%
    distinct(USERID, EVENTDATE, .keep_all = TRUE)

  sum_journey <- risk_subset %>%
    transmute(USERID, EVENTDATE, EVENTDATE_COPY = EVENTDATE) %>%
    full_join(journey_df[, c("USERID", "EVENTDATE", "Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D")],
              by = c("USERID", "EVENTDATE")) %>%
    mutate(EVENTDATE = as.Date(EVENTDATE), EVENTDATE_COPY = as.Date(EVENTDATE_COPY)) %>%
    arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      .rn         = row_number(),
      .first_pop  = suppressWarnings(min(.rn[!is.na(EVENTDATE_COPY)])),
      .first_pop  = ifelse(is.infinite(.first_pop), NA_integer_, .first_pop),
      .second_pop = {
        pos <- sort(.rn[!is.na(EVENTDATE_COPY)])
        if (length(pos) >= 2) pos[2] else NA_integer_
      },
      .end_row    = ifelse(!is.na(.second_pop), .second_pop - 1L, max(.rn)),
      SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D = ifelse(
        !is.na(.first_pop) & .rn == .first_pop,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[.rn >= .first_pop & .rn <= .end_row], na.rm = TRUE),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-starts_with("."))

  score_end_names <- paste0(score_cols, "_AT_END_RISK_", suffix)

  out <- risk_subset %>%
    arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      END_RISK_final = lead(END_RISK),
      # pull each score column's value from the NEXT row (the END_RISK
      # marker row) onto the START_RISK row, same trick as END_RISK
      across(all_of(score_cols), ~ lead(.x), .names = paste0("{.col}_AT_END_RISK_", suffix))
    ) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(USERID, START_RISK, END_RISK_final, all_of(score_end_names)) %>%
    left_join(
      sum_journey %>% filter(!is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D)) %>% select(USERID, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D),
      by = "USERID"
    )

  names(out)[names(out) == "END_RISK_final"]     <- paste0("END_RISK_", suffix)
  names(out)[names(out) == "SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D"]   <- paste0("SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_", suffix)

  out
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build the 1-, 3-, and 6-month outcome tables and combine
#    (12-month outcome pair removed per request)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
score_cols <- c("STRESSLEVEL", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY",
                 "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL")

outcomes_1 <- build_outcome_table(build_end_risk(abc, 1), Comp_DF, "1", score_cols)
outcomes_3 <- build_outcome_table(build_end_risk(abc, 3), Comp_DF, "3", score_cols)
outcomes_6 <- build_outcome_table(build_end_risk(abc, 6), Comp_DF, "6", score_cols)

# score values AT the START_RISK timepoint (same physical row regardless
# of follow-up window, so computed once here rather than per suffix)
start_scores <- abc %>%
  filter(START_RISK == 1) %>%
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(USERID, all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_AT_START_RISK"), all_of(score_cols))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Sums of Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D BEFORE START_RISK: 1, 3, and 6 months
#    prior to the START_RISK date (window is [start_date - N months,
#    start_date), i.e. up to but not including the START_RISK row
#    itself).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
start_dates <- abc %>%
  filter(START_RISK == 1) %>%
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(USERID, START_RISK_DATE = EVENTDATE)

before_sums <- start_dates %>%
  left_join(Comp_DF[, c("USERID", "EVENTDATE", "Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D")], by = "USERID") %>%
  mutate(EVENTDATE = as.Date(EVENTDATE)) %>%
  group_by(USERID, START_RISK_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1 = sum(
      Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= START_RISK_DATE %m-% months(1) & EVENTDATE < START_RISK_DATE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3 = sum(
      Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= START_RISK_DATE %m-% months(3) & EVENTDATE < START_RISK_DATE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6 = sum(
      Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= START_RISK_DATE %m-% months(6) & EVENTDATE < START_RISK_DATE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-START_RISK_DATE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Combine everything into one wide table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
six_month_outcomes <- outcomes_1 %>%
  full_join(outcomes_3 %>% select(-START_RISK), by = "USERID") %>%
  full_join(outcomes_6 %>% select(-START_RISK), by = "USERID") %>%
  full_join(before_sums, by = "USERID") %>%
  full_join(start_scores, by = "USERID") %>%
  select(USERID, START_RISK,
         END_RISK_1, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_1,
         END_RISK_3, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_3,
         END_RISK_6, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_6,
         SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6,
         ends_with("_AT_START_RISK"),
         ends_with("_AT_END_RISK_1"),
         ends_with("_AT_END_RISK_3"),
         ends_with("_AT_END_RISK_6"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. "INCREASE" flags: YES/NO/NA comparisons of each after-timepoint
#    value against its corresponding before/start baseline
#    - JOURNEY_INCREASE_<n>: after (1/3/6 month window sum) vs. before
#      (same-length window prior to START_RISK)
#    - <SCORE>_INCREASE_<n>: value AT the END_RISK_<n> marker vs. value
#      AT the START_RISK row
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
six_month_outcomes <- six_month_outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_1) | is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_1 > SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_3) | is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_3 > SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_6) | is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_6 > SUM_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),

    # --- STRESSLEVEL ---
    STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1) | is.na(STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1 > STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                 ~ "NO"
    ),
    STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_3) | is.na(STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_3 > STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                 ~ "NO"
    ),
    STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_6) | is.na(STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_6 > STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                 ~ "NO"
    ),

    # --- MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL ---
    MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1) | is.na(MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1 > MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                 ~ "NO"
    ),
    MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_3) | is.na(MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_3 > MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                 ~ "NO"
    ),
    MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_6) | is.na(MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_6 > MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                 ~ "NO"
    ),

    # --- FEELINGSFREQUENCY ---
    FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_END_RISK_1) | is.na(FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_END_RISK_1 > FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                             ~ "NO"
    ),
    FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_END_RISK_3) | is.na(FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_END_RISK_3 > FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                             ~ "NO"
    ),
    FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_END_RISK_6) | is.na(FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_END_RISK_6 > FEELINGSFREQUENCY_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                             ~ "NO"
    ),

    # --- DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING ---
    DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_END_RISK_1) | is.na(DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_END_RISK_1 > DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),
    DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_END_RISK_3) | is.na(DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_END_RISK_3 > DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),
    DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_END_RISK_6) | is.na(DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_END_RISK_6 > DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),

    # --- MANAGESTRESSLEVEL ---
    MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1) | is.na(MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1 > MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                             ~ "NO"
    ),
    MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_3) | is.na(MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_3 > MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                             ~ "NO"
    ),
    MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_6) | is.na(MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK) ~ NA_character_,
      MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_6 > MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                             ~ "NO"
```

# Daily Case Counts - from first EVENTDATE

``` {r daily_case_counts}

########################################################################
# Add BEFORE / AFTER window columns per USERID
#
# For each USERID, and for each window length in {1 week, 2 weeks,
# 1 month, 3 months, 6 months}:
#
#   BEFORE window = [first EVENTDATE for that USERID,
#                     first EVENTDATE + window length)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_<suffix>      = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_<suffix>  = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#     COUNT_FEELING2_BEFORE_<suffix>          = number of times FEELINGRATING == 2 in that window
#
#   AFTER window  = [the EVENTDATE immediately following the LAST
#                     EVENTDATE included in the BEFORE_<suffix> window,
#                     that same start date + window length)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_<suffix>       = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_<suffix>   = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#     COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER_<suffix>           = number of times FEELINGRATING == 2 in that window
#
# suffix is one of: 1WK, 2WK, 1, 3, 6 (the last three being months)
#
# NOTE: the "last EVENTDATE in the BEFORE window" (and therefore the
# start of the AFTER window) is recalculated separately for EACH window
# length, since a longer BEFORE window naturally ends later. So each
# AFTER_<suffix> window starts on a different date.
#
# All 30 new columns (mean/sum/count x before/after x 5 window lengths)
# are broadcast onto EVERY row for that USERID before being collapsed
# down to a single row per USERID in the final step below.
#
# If a USERID has no EVENTDATE after a given BEFORE window closes, the
# AFTER columns for that window length are NA.
########################################################################

# ---- 1. Read in the data -------------------------------------------------
daily_cases <- Comp_DF
daily_cases$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(daily_cases$EVENTDATE, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# ---- 2. Helper: build BEFORE/AFTER mean + sum + count columns for one
#         window length, returning one row per USERID with columns
#         suffixed by that window length. `add_period` is a function
#         that takes a Date and returns that date plus the window
#         length (e.g. `function(d) d %m+% months(3)` or
#         `function(d) d + weeks(1)`), which lets the same helper
#         handle both week- and month-based windows. -----------------
build_before_after <- function(data, add_period, suffix) {
  data %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(
      .baseline_date = min(EVENTDATE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before_end    = add_period(.baseline_date),

      .before_last_date = suppressWarnings(max(
        EVENTDATE[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .before_last_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.before_last_date), NA, .before_last_date),
                                   origin = "1970-01-01"),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE = mean(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE = sum(
        Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING2_BEFORE = sum(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end] == 2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # AFTER window starts at the next EVENTDATE strictly after the
      # last date included in the BEFORE window
      .after_start = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(.before_last_date) & EVENTDATE > .before_last_date],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .after_start = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.after_start), NA, .after_start),
                              origin = "1970-01-01"),
      .after_end   = add_period(.after_start),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end] == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -USERID)
}

# ---- 3. Build the 1-week, 2-week, 1-, 3-, and 6-month BEFORE/AFTER
#         tables and merge them back onto every row of the original
#         data ----------------------------------------------------------
windows_1wk <- build_before_after(daily_cases, function(d) d + weeks(1), "1WK")
windows_2wk <- build_before_after(daily_cases, function(d) d + weeks(2), "2WK")
windows_1   <- build_before_after(daily_cases, function(d) d %m+% months(1), "1")
windows_3   <- build_before_after(daily_cases, function(d) d %m+% months(3), "3")
windows_6   <- build_before_after(daily_cases, function(d) d %m+% months(6), "6")

daily_cases <- daily_cases %>%
  left_join(windows_1wk, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_2wk, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_1, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_3, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_6, by = "USERID")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MEAN_FEELINGRATING change: raw difference (after - before) and a
#    recoded 3-level version for each window length
#    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_<suffix>   = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_<suffix> - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_<suffix>
#    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_<suffix> = "SAME"     if |diff| <  0.25
#                                          "IMPROVED" if  diff  >  0.25
#                                          "WORSENED" if  diff  <= -0.25
#    NOTE: as specified, a difference of EXACTLY +0.25 falls into none
#    of the three buckets (not < 0.25, not > 0.25, not <= -0.25) and is
#    left as NA below. If you'd rather +0.25 count as "IMPROVED", change
#    the ">" to ">=" in the IMPROVED condition.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases <- daily_cases %>%
  mutate(
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1WK - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1WK,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_2WK - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_2WK,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1   = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1   - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3   = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3   - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6   = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6   - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6,

    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1WK = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_2WK = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. JOURNEY_INCREASE flags: does Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D go up from the
#    BEFORE window to the AFTER window, for each window length?
#    Mirrors the SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_<n> / SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_<n>
#    pattern, using SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_<n> /
#    SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_<n> instead.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases <- daily_cases %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1WK = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1WK) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1WK) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1WK > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1WK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_2WK = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_2WK) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_2WK) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_2WK > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_2WK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    )
  )

daily_cases <- daily_cases %>% 
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Print range + average of SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D and
#    COUNT_FEELING2, across USERIDs, for each BEFORE/AFTER window
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
print_range_avg <- function(data, col_name, label) {
  vals <- data[[col_name]]
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": no valid data\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-55s Range: %6s to %-6s | Average: %s\n",
              label, round(min(vals), 2), round(max(vals), 2), round(mean(vals), 2)))
}

window_suffixes <- c("1WK", "2WK", "1", "3", "6")

for (s in window_suffixes) {
  print_range_avg(daily_cases, paste0("SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_", s),
                   paste0("Comp Journey Use (Sum) -- BEFORE ", s))
  print_range_avg(daily_cases, paste0("SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_", s),
                   paste0("Comp Journey Use (Sum) -- AFTER ", s))
  print_range_avg(daily_cases, paste0("COUNT_FEELING2_BEFORE_", s),
                   paste0("# Times FEELINGRATING = 2 -- BEFORE ", s))
  print_range_avg(daily_cases, paste0("COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER_", s),
                   paste0("# Times FEELINGRATING = 2 -- AFTER ", s))
}

write.csv(daily_cases, "G:/My Drive/Inzights/Journey/July 2026 Longitudinal/daily_cases_startline.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Daily Case Counts - Low Scores

``` {r daily_case_counts_low_scores}

########################################################################
# Add BEFORE / AFTER window columns per USERID
# VARIANT: restricted to USERIDs who have EVER reported a FEELINGRATING
# of 1 or 2, with the BEFORE windows starting at the FIRST EVENTDATE at
# which a 1 or 2 value was observed (not simply that USERID's earliest
# EVENTDATE overall).
#
# For each qualifying USERID, and for each window length in {1 week,
# 2 weeks, 1, 3, 6 months}:
#
#   BASELINE_DATE = first EVENTDATE for that USERID where
#                    FEELINGRATING %in% c(1, 2)
#
#   BEFORE window = [BASELINE_DATE, BASELINE_DATE + window length)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_<suffix>      = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_<suffix>  = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#     COUNT_FEELING2_BEFORE_<suffix>          = number of times FEELINGRATING == 2 in that window
#
#   AFTER window  = [the EVENTDATE immediately following the LAST
#                     EVENTDATE included in the BEFORE_<suffix> window,
#                     that same start date + window length)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_<suffix>       = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_<suffix>   = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#     COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER_<suffix>           = number of times FEELINGRATING == 2 in that window
#
# USERIDs who never reported a FEELINGRATING of 1 or 2 are dropped
# entirely before any of the BEFORE/AFTER calculations run.
########################################################################


# ---- 1. Read in the data, restrict to qualifying USERIDs -----------------
daily_cases_low_feeling <- Comp_DF
daily_cases_low_feeling$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(daily_cases_low_feeling$EVENTDATE, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

qualifying_userids <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING), FEELINGRATING %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  distinct(USERID) %>%
  pull(USERID)

daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  filter(USERID %in% qualifying_userids)

# ---- 2. Baseline date per USERID: first EVENTDATE where FEELINGRATING
#         is 1 or 2 (this replaces "first EVENTDATE overall" as the
#         BEFORE-window start) --------------------------------------------
baseline_dates <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING), FEELINGRATING %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  summarise(BASELINE_DATE = min(EVENTDATE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- 3. Helper: build BEFORE/AFTER mean + sum + count columns for one
#         window length, returning one row per USERID with columns
#         suffixed by that window length. `baseline_dates` supplies the
#         per-USERID BEFORE-window start date. `add_period` is a
#         function that takes a Date and returns that date plus the
#         window length (e.g. `function(d) d %m+% months(3)` or
#         `function(d) d + weeks(1)`), letting the same helper handle
#         both week- and month-based windows. -------------------------
build_before_after <- function(data, baseline_dates, add_period, suffix) {
  data %>%
    left_join(baseline_dates, by = "USERID") %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(
      .before_end = add_period(BASELINE_DATE[1]),

      .before_last_date = suppressWarnings(max(
        EVENTDATE[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .before_last_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.before_last_date), NA, .before_last_date),
                                   origin = "1970-01-01"),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE = mean(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE = sum(
        Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING1_BEFORE = sum(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end] == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING2_BEFORE = sum(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end] == 2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # AFTER window starts at the next EVENTDATE strictly after the
      # last date included in the BEFORE window
      .after_start = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(.before_last_date) & EVENTDATE > .before_last_date],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .after_start = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.after_start), NA, .after_start),
                              origin = "1970-01-01"),
      .after_end   = add_period(.after_start),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING1_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end] == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -USERID)
}

# ---- 4. Build the 1-week, 2-week, 1-, 3-, and 6-month BEFORE/AFTER
#         tables and merge them back onto every row of the (filtered)
#         data -----------------------------------------------------------
windows_1wk <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, function(d) d + weeks(1), "1WK")
windows_2wk <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, function(d) d + weeks(2), "2WK")
windows_1   <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, function(d) d %m+% months(1), "1")
windows_3   <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, function(d) d %m+% months(3), "3")
windows_6   <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, function(d) d %m+% months(6), "6")

daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  left_join(windows_1wk, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_2wk, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_1, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_3, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_6, by = "USERID")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. MEAN_FEELINGRATING change: raw difference (after - before) and a
#    recoded 3-level version for each window length
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  mutate(
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1WK - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1WK,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_2WK - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_2WK,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6,

    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1WK = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_2WK = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. JOURNEY_INCREASE flags: does Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D go up from the
#    BEFORE window to the AFTER window, for each window length?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1WK = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1WK) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1WK) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1WK > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1WK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_2WK = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_2WK) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_2WK) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_2WK > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_2WK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    )
  )

daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>% 
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Print range + average of SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D and
#    COUNT_FEELING2, across USERIDs, for each BEFORE/AFTER window
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

print_range_avg <- function(data, col_name, label) {
  vals <- data[[col_name]]
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": no valid data\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-55s Range: %6s to %-6s | Average: %s\n",
              label, round(min(vals), 1), round(max(vals), 1), round(mean(vals), 1)))
}
```

# Daily Case Counts - Rolling Min

``` {r daily_case_counts_rolling_min}

daily_cases_rolling_min <- Comp_DF

daily_cases_rolling_min$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(daily_cases_rolling_min$EVENTDATE, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# ---- 2. Baseline date per USERID: the EVENTDATE that starts the 1-month
#         window with the LOWEST mean FEELINGRATING for that USERID -------
#         NOTE: this rolling search is always exactly 1 month wide,
#         regardless of which BEFORE/AFTER window length (1WK, 2WK, 1,
#         3, 6 months) is being built below -- it only locates
#         BASELINE_DATE itself. -------------------------------------
baseline_dates <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(
    # rolling 1-month mean FEELINGRATING, using each observed EVENTDATE
    # as a candidate window start
    .rolling_mean_1mo = sapply(seq_along(EVENTDATE), function(i) {
      window_end <- EVENTDATE[i] %m+% months(1)
      mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= EVENTDATE[i] & EVENTDATE < window_end], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    BASELINE_DATE = {
      valid <- !is.nan(.rolling_mean_1mo) & !is.na(.rolling_mean_1mo)
      if (any(valid)) {
        EVENTDATE[valid][which.min(.rolling_mean_1mo[valid])]
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 3. Helper: build BEFORE/AFTER mean + sum + count columns for one
#         window length, returning one row per USERID with columns
#         suffixed by that window length. `baseline_dates` supplies the
#         per-USERID BEFORE-window start date. `add_period` is a
#         function that takes a Date and returns that date plus the
#         window length (e.g. `function(d) d %m+% months(3)` or
#         `function(d) d + weeks(1)`), letting the same helper handle
#         both week- and month-based windows. -------------------------
build_before_after <- function(data, baseline_dates, add_period, suffix) {
  data %>%
    left_join(baseline_dates, by = "USERID") %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(
      .before_end = add_period(BASELINE_DATE[1]),

      .before_last_date = suppressWarnings(max(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(BASELINE_DATE) & EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .before_last_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.before_last_date), NA, .before_last_date),
                                   origin = "1970-01-01"),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE = ifelse(
        is.na(BASELINE_DATE[1]), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE = ifelse(
        is.na(BASELINE_DATE[1]), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING2_BEFORE = ifelse(
        is.na(BASELINE_DATE[1]), NA_real_,
        sum(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end] == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),

      # AFTER window starts at the next EVENTDATE strictly after the
      # last date included in the BEFORE window
      .after_start = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(.before_last_date) & EVENTDATE > .before_last_date],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .after_start = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.after_start), NA, .after_start),
                              origin = "1970-01-01"),
      .after_end   = add_period(.after_start),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end] == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -USERID)
}

# ---- 4. Build the 1-week, 2-week, 1-, 3-, and 6-month BEFORE/AFTER
#         tables and merge them back onto every row of the data --------
windows_1wk <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, function(d) d + weeks(1), "1WK")
windows_2wk <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, function(d) d + weeks(2), "2WK")
windows_1   <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, function(d) d %m+% months(1), "1")
windows_3   <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, function(d) d %m+% months(3), "3")
windows_6   <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, function(d) d %m+% months(6), "6")

daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  left_join(windows_1wk, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_2wk, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_1, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_3, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_6, by = "USERID")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. MEAN_FEELINGRATING change: raw difference (after - before) and a
#    recoded 3-level version for each window length
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  mutate(
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1WK - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1WK,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_2WK - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_2WK,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6,

    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1WK = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1WK <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_2WK = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_2WK <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. JOURNEY_INCREASE flags: does Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D go up from the
#    BEFORE window to the AFTER window, for each window length?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1WK = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1WK) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1WK) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1WK > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1WK                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                                ~ "NO"

      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_2WK > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_2WK                ~ "YES",
```
